title: Divisible pulse windows with bounded length

cases.name: small_exhaustive
cases.code:
import random
rnd = random.Random(3)
xs = [rnd.randint(-20, 20) for _ in range(60)]
result = [sol.count_pulses(xs, k, lo, hi)
          for k in (1, 4, 7, 10**9)
          for lo, hi in ((1, 60), (1, 1), (30, 45), (60, 60))]

cases.name: large_band
cases.code:
import random
rnd = random.Random(0)
deltas = [rnd.randint(-10**6, 10**6) for _ in range(1200000)]
result = sol.count_pulses(deltas, 1000, 100000, 350000)

cases.name: large_full_range_progression
cases.code:
deltas = [((i * i) % 2001) - 1000 for i in range(1000000)]
result = sol.count_pulses(deltas, 7, 1, 1000000)
